mechanism: Amiodarone inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, increasing mebendazole metabolism inhibition and potentially elevating mebendazole levels; mebendazole may also prolong QT interval and interact with amiodarone's cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased mebendazole adverse effects (hepatotoxicity, GI disturbance) and cardiac arrhythmias; consider ECG monitoring and liver function tests; use alternative anthelmintic if possible.
